source: Windows SendInput / UIA, actual Electron + daemon + SQLite + managed SDK private IPC and local HTTP fixture. No CDP or renderer request routing.
limitations: One explicit fail-once host fault before decision consumption; not a physical disk failure. Durable save failure is separately covered by service tests.
A separate hold fixture ended with actual error / terminated; this is not recorded as an explicit abort success.

Pending command was inspected in a native dark 802px confirmation and Escape cancelled; it was invalidated on normal exit and never executed. Actual command execution is covered by Electron automated tests.
Application restart does not promise per-window draft persistence.
